_: Who can be in a short. voice: an ElevenLabs voice name (or its id) from your account; `npm run short -- --voices` lists them. look: what they are, for the video model. lipsync: false for anyone without a mouth to sync (they move and the voice plays over). image: a picture to use instead of the game's (or drop one in shorts/characters/<id>.png).

pimples.name: Pimples
pimples.look: a bald pale head on a long neck, its face covered in red pimples, bloodshot eyes

stubble.name: Stubble
stubble.look: a bald man's head with pointed ears, a heavy stubble shadow and tired red-rimmed eyes

droopy.name: Droopy
